title: build(native): map ffmpeg macro roots via -fmacro-prefix-map
body:
## What

One-line build-policy fix plus its evidence archive, from the SongCore #329 Q2 campaign (release blocker in #172):

1. **`native/build/ffmpeg.lua`** — inside the `qianqian_av` `on_load`, immediately after `target:add("includedirs", buildroot, srcroot, {public = true})`, add the single winning flag:

   ```lua
   target:add("cflags", "-fmacro-prefix-map=" .. srcroot .. "=.", {force = true})
   ```

   The line is byte-identical to the campaign's validated patch: `diff` of this file against each campaign build-root clone's patched file is empty, and against its pristine copy the diff is exactly this one added line.

2. **`evidence/songcore-172/q2-crossroot/`** — new evidence archive: two-target R1↔R2 cmp tables + `verdict.json` (winner + E0 controls), the 12-variant experiment matrix, per-root and per-arm fix-witness compile-command censuses, per-root and per-arm build receipts plus per-arm leak censuses (clone/closure provenance), six G1+G2 gate receipts + generated summary, byte-identical copies of the three campaign scripts (build, compare, comparator), and `t4-verdict-and-L.md`. The README documents method, counterfactual arm semantics, occurrence accounting, and boundaries. Non-authoritative evidence under `evidence/` rules; no product code change beyond the flag line above.

## Experiment matrix (T4, one flag at a time)

R1/R2 = two independent absolute build roots per target; identical = cross-root full-archive sha256 equality + 282/282 member-occurrence equality.

| arm | linux | windows |
|---|---|---|
| E0 no map (control) | differs (9 occ; absolute root literals in archives) | differs (9 occ) |
| `-ffile-prefix-map=<ffmpeg srcroot>=.` | identical | identical (not adopted) |
| counterfactual: each root maps its own compiled FFmpeg src root; R1 target `.` (retained `mapto="."` product: the filemap arm's for `filemap-ctr`, the winner arm's for `macromap-ctr`; byte-identical) vs R2 target `src` (rebuilt) | differs (9 occ; 0 build-root hits either side) | differs (9 occ; 0 build-root hits either side) |
| `-fmacro-prefix-map=<ffmpeg srcroot>=.` (winner) | identical | identical |

Fix witness: on every root, `compile_commands_entries=281`, `fmacro_prefix_map_entries=279`, `ffile_prefix_map_entries=0`; the two no-map controls record 0/0; the four ctr witnesses record the ctr flag on 279/281 entries — the flag demonstrably reaches the replayed FFmpeg compile units.

Census definitions (E0). The two censuses are not interchangeable. The build-receipt census (`b329-build.sh`'s whole-artifact scan, all 280 members; e.g. `build-receipts/linux-lin-r1-a1-none.leak-census.txt` and the `*-e0-*.leak-census.txt` files) records 9 `<root>/src` occurrences per root in linux static, 3 per root in linux shared and 9 per root in windows static. The verdict census (`cmp/controls/<target>-e0-verdict.json`, `b329-arcmp.py` `leak_scan`) only scans content-bearing rows — 224/282 on linux, 185/282 on windows — and records 5 full-root-prefix hits per side in linux static and 1 per side in windows static, plus 1 `/tmp/` source literal per side (`file_open.c.o`, unrelated to this fix). The count gap (linux 4, windows 8) is folded-member territory: 4 `<symbol-table-ext>` DIFF rows on linux and 7 on windows, plus path literals inside folded bodies. The winner arms record 0 build-root hits under both censuses on both targets; the verdict census still records the 1 `/tmp/` literal per side.

## Correction to the earlier counterfactual wording

An earlier revision of this body and of the archived evidence described the `*-ctr` arms as a map-coverage counterexample. That was wrong. The build-root receipts show both roots mapped their own compiled FFmpeg source root as the `from` prefix; the varied parameter was the replacement target (R1 `.` vs R2 `src`), and R1 was not rebuilt in those arms — it retains a `mapto="."` product (the filemap arm's archive for `filemap-ctr`, the winner arm's for `macromap-ctr`; byte-identical). The 9 differing member occurrences and the zero build-root verdict census on both sides are measured; attributing the surviving bytes to the replacement target string is inference, because the ctr R2 products were overwritten before archiving and the differing literals were not captured. Details: `evidence/songcore-172/q2-crossroot/README.md` §"Counterfactual arm semantics".

## Cross-root result

- linux: static `7b506922…` AND shared `085425e5…` sha256 identical across R1/R2 (282/282 occurrences, order identical, 9 comparator duplicate-name entries equal by occurrence index — see README occurrence accounting — `HEADER_ANOMALIES=0`)
- windows: static `d8c8e688…` identical across R1/R2 (static-only form this round)

Occurrence accounting (re-checked against the winner archives): the 282 comparison rows are 280 real ar members + 2 archive metadata entries (`<symbol-table>` `/`, `<longnames>` `//`); 56 (linux) / 95 (windows) long-name members appear under the synthetic `<symbol-table-ext>` label because of a v1 comparator branch-ordering defect. They are still compared occurrence by occurrence with `ORDER_IDENTICAL=yes`, so verdicts/digests are unaffected, but the defect has two consequences: unreadable names and incomplete verdict-census coverage (224/282 linux, 185/282 windows). The real duplicate accounting is 9 names / 13 extra occurrences, while the comparator's `DUPLICATE_NAMES=9` is 8 real duplicate names + 1 synthetic group; the `mpegaudiodsp` name-level conclusion comes from a live-archive re-check (`ar t <archive> | sort | uniq -c | awk '$1>1'`), not from the archived TSV. No verdict changes; see README §"Occurrence accounting and comparator naming (v1)".

## Gate conclusions (six roots, G1+G2)

All six roots (`linux-lin-r1`, `linux-linux-root-two`, `linux-lin-l1-route`, `windows-win-r1`, `windows-windows-root-two`, `windows-win-l1-route`): receipt verdict **PASS**, `failures` empty, staged-artifact sha match; G1 (member-format + 15/15 ABI symbol audit; shared export audit on linux) PASS; G2 all 5 corpus fixtures PASS per form (scenario + lifetime + truncation variants vs the frozen reference). Windows G2: the consumer PE executed on the real Windows host via `cmd.exe` interop (per receipt `g2_forms_note`).

## L determination

- **L1: PASS both targets** — fresh clone + freshly derived closure routes archived (`linux-lin-l1-route`, `windows-win-l1-route`); windows is the mingw-w64 cross route only.
- **L2: PASS both targets within scope** — G2-on-R2 alongside R1, including native Windows PE runtime via cmd.exe interop; windows shared form **NOT RUN** (static-only per release contract §6; no static-only artifact is counted as Windows shared support).
- **L3: measured byte identity of shipped artifacts across roots** (linux static+shared, windows static); release-level ratification **NOT RUN** — remains with #172 G4.
- **NOT ESTABLISHED**: MSVC/native toolchain routes, windows shared form, new RC. **No Windows SUPPORTED claim.** No tag, no release.

## Base note

The branch is pinned to the campaign base `b49b18cd68ae1a353cd3396efb3977b8590cc4d1` (the #328 merge recorded by every archived receipt). `main` has since advanced one commit (#331) touching `AGENTS.md`, docs, `ops/` and release tools — no overlap with this delta (`native/build/ffmpeg.lua` + a new evidence directory).

## Checks run in this branch's clone (WSL)

Latest commit: `12ab8386ecd0` — `docs(evidence): correct leak-census coverage claims` (round-4 review fixes); earlier: `4d2cb09f2d71` — `docs(evidence): fix arm wording and archive E0 census`, `baf8e710b5f6` — `docs(evidence): correct counterfactual arm semantics` and `f0c5354fb0c7` — `docs(evidence): tighten the withdrawn counterfactual wording`. All are evidence-only; no implementation line changed.

- `python3 tools/check_architecture_vocabulary.py` → `VOCABULARY GATE PASS: no stale identifiers found; workflow negative control FAIL→PASS verified`
- `python3 tools/check_commit_convention.py --self-test` → `PASS: self-test (11 valid, 12 invalid cases)`
- `python3 tools/check_commit_convention.py --message "$(git log -1 --format=%s HEAD)"` → `PASS: message: docs(evidence): correct leak-census coverage claims` (the earlier headers also passed the same check)
- `python3 tools/check_commit_convention.py --range origin/main HEAD` → PASS for `f74265045a8a`, `baf8e710b5f6`, `f0c5354fb0c7`, `4d2cb09f2d71` and `12ab8386ecd0`

Not run: the manual full-tree gate `lefthook run pre-push --all-files` — its `docs-verify` step requires `website/node_modules`, which this clone does not have, and the Rust/plugin-boundary steps do not apply to an evidence-only delta. Rust paths are unchanged in this delta, so no cargo loop is required locally; platform/formal/audio evidence remains GitHub Actions' authority per the pre-push gate contract. Do not merge without the independent Build/ABI/Distribution reviews required by #329.
